questionEn: Which formulation more accurately distinguishes “The Biological Significance of Oxygen and Ozone” from similar ideas?
questionUz: Qaysi formula "Kislorod va ozonning biologik ahamiyati" ni o'xshash g'oyalardan aniqroq ajratib turadi?
choicesEn: Anaerobic bacteria and deep sea creatures do not need oxygen, all other organisms do.
A complex substance of two elements, one of which is oxygen
choicesUz: Anaerob bakteriyalar va chuqur dengiz jonzotlari kislorodga muhtoj emas, boshqa barcha organizmlar.
Ikki elementdan iborat murakkab modda, ulardan biri kislorod
explanationEn: Anaerobic bacteria and deep sea creatures do not require oxygen, all other organisms require oxygen.
explanationUz: Anaerob bakteriyalar va chuqur dengiz jonzotlari kislorodga muhtoj emas, qolgan barcha organizmlar kislorodga muhtoj.
